ἅλων.en: ἅλων word a threshing-floor, a place where corn is trodden out

ἐγγίζω.en: ἐγγίζω word pr. to cause to approach

ἐγγύς.en: ἐγγύς (preposição): some view as an improper prep., followed by gen. or dat., near, as to place, Lk. 19:11

ἐγώ.en: ἐγώ word I, gen., ἐμοῦ [μου], dat., ἐμοί [μοι], acc., ἐμέ [με]

ἐκ.en: ἐκ (advérbio): ἐχ before vowels, with genitive, from, out of, a place, Mt. 2:15

ἐκδικέω.en: ἐκδικέω word pr. to execute right and justice

ἐκεῖνος.en: ἐκεῖνος (substantivo): demonstrative adjective or noun, that, this, he, etc., Mt. 17:27

ἐκλείπω.en: ἐκλείπω (verbo): to fail, die out, Lk. 22:32

ἐκχέω.en: ἐκχέω word also formed as ἐκχύννομαι , to pour out, Rev. 16:1, 2, 3

ἐκῥιζόω.en: ἐκριζόω (verbo): to root up, eradicate, pull out by the roots, Mt. 13:29

ἐν.en: ἐν word followed by the dat., in, Mt. 8:6

ἐνώπιον.en: ἐνώπιον word gen., before, in the presence of, Lk. 5:25

ἐπικαλέω.en: ἐπικαλέω word pluperfect, ἐπεκέκλητο , to call on

ἐπισκέπτομαι.en: ἐπισκέπτομαι (verbo): to look at observantly, to inspect

ἐπιστρέφω.en: ἐπιστρέφω word trans. to turn towards

ἐπιφανής.en: επιφανης word coming to light, coming suddenly into view, appearing

ἐπιφαίνω.en: ἐπιφαίνω (verbo): to make to appear, to display

ἐπιφυλλίς.en: επιφυλλις word small grapes left for gleaners

ἐπιἄγω.en: trazer upon/above trazer against trazer adiante

ἐπί.en: ἐπί word with the gen., upon, on, Mt. 4:6

ἑορτή.en: ἑορτή word a solemn feast, public festival, Lk. 2:41

ἑτοιμάζω.en: ἑτοιμάζω (verbo): to make ready, prepare, Mt. 22:4

ἔθνος.en: ἔθνος word a multitude, company, Acts 17:26

ἔρημος.en: ἔρημος word lone, desert, waste, uninhabited, Mt. 14:13, 15

ἕκαστος.en: ἕκαστος word each , every separately, Mt. 16:27

ἕνεκεν.en: for/by causa of for/by love of (preposição)

ἡμέρα.en: ἡμέρα word day, a day, the interval from sunrise to sunset, opp. to νύξ, Mt. 4:2

ἰδού.en: ἰδού word aorist middle imperative of εἶδον used as an interjection, Look! See! Lo! Mt. 1:23

ἰερουσαλήμ.en: Ἰερουσαλήμ (nome próprio): Jerusalem, pr. name, indecl., also spelled Ἱεροσόλυμα 62x in our text. See PhotoGuide.

ἰούδας.en: Ἰούδας (nome próprio): Judas, Jude, pr. name. Judah, son of Jacob

ἰσραήλ.en: Ἰσραήλ (nome próprio): Israel, pr. name, indecl.

ἱερεύς.en: ἱερεύς word a priest, one who performs sacrificial rites, Mt. 8:4

ὀνειδίζω.en: ὀνειδίζω (verbo): to censure, inveigh against, Mt. 11:20

ὀργή.en: ὀργή word pr. mental bent, impulse

ὀρθρίζω.en: ὀρθρίζω (verbo): to rise early in the morning

ὁ.en: ὁ (preposição): the prepositive article, answering, to a considerable extent, to the English definite a…

ὁμοιόω.en: ὁμοιόω (verbo): to make like, cause to be like or resemble, assimilate

ὁμίχλη.en: ὁμίχλη word a mist, fog, a cloud, 2 Pet. 2:17

ὁράω.en: ὁράω word pluperfect, ἑωράκειν, some list εἶδον as the second aorist of ὁράω, to see, behold, Mt.…

ὄμνυμι.en: ομνυμι word given my word of honour

ὄρος.en: ὄρος word a mountain, hill, Mt. 5:1, 14

ὅλος.en: ὅλος word all, whole, entire, Mt. 1:22

ὅπως.en: ὅπως (conjunção): can function as a conj., how, in what way or manner, by what means, Mt. 22:5

ὅριον.en: ὅριον word a limit, bound, border of a territory or country

ὅς.en: ὅς word who, which, what, that, Mt. 1:16, 23, 25

ὅσος.en: ὅσος word as great, as much, Mk. 7:36

ὅτι.en: ὅτι (partícula): originally was the neuter of ὅστις, that, Mt. 2:16, 22, 23

ὑπερήφανος.en: ὑπερήφανος word assuming, haughty, arrogant, Lk. 1:51

ὑπολείπω.en: ὑπολείπω (verbo): to leave remaining, leave behind

ὑπομένω.en: ὑπομένω (partícula): intrans. to remain or stay behind, when others have departed, Lk. 2:43

ὑψηλός.en: ὑψηλός word high, lofty, elevated, Mt. 4:8

ὡς.en: ὡς (pronome): conjunction formed from the relative pronoun ὅς, used as a comparative part. and conj.,…

ῥομφαία.en: ῥομφαία word pr. a Thracian broad-sword
